config.title: Antigravity Fusion Panel
config.defaultTab.description: Default active tab when opening the fusion panel.
config.statusBar.enabled.description: Show live fusion panel status capsules in the bottom status bar.
config.statusBar.showAccount.description: Show active account switcher capsule in the bottom status bar.
config.statusBar.showCache.description: Show live prompt cache hit rate and cache warmth alert status bar capsule.
config.statusBar.showSpeed.description: Show generation speed, request errors, and slow first-token wait status bar capsule.
config.statusBar.showQuota.description: Show active model quota pool (5h / weekly) status bar capsule.
config.refreshIntervalSec.description: Status bar polling interval in seconds (3-60).
config.defaultScope.description: Default telemetry scope in the agy-dart guard tab.
config.capsule.cacheWarnMin.description: Minutes since last activity before cache badge turns yellow.
config.capsule.cacheColdMin.description: Minutes since last activity before cache badge turns red.
config.capsule.queueWarnSec.description: First-token wait threshold in seconds before showing wait alert.
config.account.reloadAfterSwitch.descrip: Action after writing switched account credentials.
config.account.reloadAfterSwitch.coldRes: Auto cold-restart IDE (clears main-process cache & prevents onboarding prompts, recommended)
config.account.reloadAfterSwitch.ask: Prompt with Cold Restart / Quick Reload options
config.account.reloadAfterSwitch.auto: Quickly reload IDE window (may re-prompt onboarding on new accounts)
config.account.reloadAfterSwitch.none: Write credentials only; restart/reload manually later
config.account.syncGeminiCli.description: Also sync ~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json and google_accounts.json on switch.
config.account.syncOnboardingState.descr: Atomically sync state.vscdb onboarding entries during cold restart to prevent repeated welcome/terms prompts.
config.account.privacyMask.description: Mask email addresses across UI and status bar.
config.account.autoHealMode.description: Guard policy when OS credential loss or loginError is detected.
config.account.autoHealMode.auto: Silently restore OS credentials and prompt reload/restart
config.account.autoHealMode.notify: Show warning in status bar & panel only
config.account.keepFreshBackup.descripti: Automatically keep encrypted vault synced with newly refreshed OS OAuth tokens.
config.pluginPath.description: Optional custom path to the installed agy-dart plugin directory (auto-detected when empty).
config.nodePath.description: Optional path to Node.js (>=22) executable used to run managed workers (auto-detected when empty).
